blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has mandated electronic invoicing service providers (ESPs) to obtain a five-year accreditation and has implemented measures to prevent excessive fees and vendor lock-in. Under Revenue Memorandum Circular No. 110-2026, the BIR mandates that ESPs secure accreditation before they can deploy electronic invoicing solutions commercially, and it will […]...
